summary: Security audit remediation verified: all 20 backend tests PASSED (20/20). Validated SEC-001 OTP dev_code gating (200 with dev_code when ALLOW_DEV_OTP=true; 503 'Layanan SMS belum dikonfigurasi. Hubungi admin.' when false; env restored to true afterward). SEC-002 JWT_SECRET is a 64-hex random value, old placeholder removed. SEC-003 BOLA on files works: non-owner B is 403 for A's private upload, becomes 200 after A sends the media_path in a chat B belongs to; avatars are public-ish (any authenticated user can GET). SEC-004 upload cap: 25MB->413 'Berkas melebihi 20 MB', 2KB image->200; type allowlist: text/plain and text/html->415, image/jpeg and audio/mp4->200; download safe headers: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present; path traversal '..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd' and 'foo/../bar' both blocked (400). Message length cap: 5000->422, 4000->200. Rate-limit + CORS regression: GET /api/ returns {status:ok, app:kpchat, mock_sms:true}; OTP cooldown 30s->429 'Tunggu 30 detik'. JWT verification: token forged with OLD placeholder secret rejected 401 on /auth/me; new-secret token accepted. Full end-to-end regression: A creates direct chat, sends text, B lists messages and reacts (👍 stored); WebSocket delivery: B connected to /api/ws?token=..., A POST /messages, B received type='message' with matching text within 10s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context manager (not a security issue but flagged by FastAPI deprecation).
server.py is 882 lines; consider splitting into routers/services/models modules (>700 line guideline).

The path-traversal guard `'..' in path` is fine for the tested cases but string-based; consider Path().resolve() containment check as defense-in-depth. Current behavior returns 400 Invalid path as required.
seed_data_creation: Created two fresh users via OTP dev_code flow with timestamp-based unique phones per module. No manual DB seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. The SEC-001 gating test temporarily flips ALLOW_DEV_OTP=false and restarts the backend, which caused parallel workers to hit 502/503. Run this file with `-n 0` (serial) or keep the toggle test isolated: `pytest backend/tests/test_security.py -n 0 --junitxml=...`. ALLOW_DEV_OTP is restored to true at end of test (verified). Phones are timestamp+suffix to avoid 30s OTP cooldown across runs.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all security fixes verified working end-to-end.
